name: io.github.aj-ua/wp-headless-mcp
title: WordPress Headless
description: Read WordPress content, ACF fields, and Yoast SEO data, and safely edit drafts.

environmentVariables.name: WP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the WordPress site, without a trailing slash

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: public (read published content), editor (adds draft-only editing), or dev (adds developer tools)

environmentVariables.name: WP_USER
environmentVariables.description: WordPress user for the Application Password (editor and dev profiles)

environmentVariables.name: WP_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: WordPress Application Password (editor and dev profiles)

environmentVariables.name: WP_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to cache GET requests; 0 turns caching off

environmentVariables.name: ACF_JSON_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the theme's acf-json folder, for ACF labels, schemas, and TypeScript types

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CPTS
environmentVariables.description: Custom post type tools: auto, none, or a JSON array of {postType, singular, plural}
